segments.t: To everyone's shock, Lyova reveals that because he lives with his mother, never gambles, and saves every ruble in the bank, he actually has the money and is willing to give it all to save Chef Barinov's lifelong dream.
Лёва, ты точно попадёшь в рай.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'I put my salary in the bank.' In Russian, the idea of 'I' flows naturally into 'bank' without extra filler words.
'After all, I live with my mother.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'I' and finishing on 'Mum'.
'And Gulya also earns well.' Notice how Russian expresses 'and' and 'earns' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'And there came to be even more money.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'and' before landing on 'to become'.
'Are you ready to give away this money?' Chef Barinov brings out the contrast between 'you' and 'ready' in a few short words. Lyova answers right away.
'This is your life's work, after all.' Lyova anchors the line on 'this', while 'life' completes the thought.
'For the sake of the restaurant I grudge nothing.' The grammar packs 'for the sake of' and 'feel sorry for' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'And I will save up more for myself.' The meaning hinges on 'and' working together with 'I will save up' in spoken Russian. Chef Barinov answers right away.
Лёва, ты точно попадёшь в рай.
'Lyova, you will definitely go to heaven.' Chef Barinov brings out the contrast between 'Lyova' and 'you' in a few short words.
'Lyova, fly quickly to the bank.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'Lyova' and finishing on 'bank'.
'First I will receive my money.' Notice how Russian expresses 'at first' and 'money' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Chef Barinov answers right away.
'I must see your review.' Chef Barinov anchors the line on 'I', while 'review' completes the thought. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Лёва, ты точно попадёшь в рай.
Just as the deal with the inspector is nearly sealed, Fedya walks in with a confession that blows the whole truce apart. See you next time!
